claim_text: NF1 encodes neurofibromin a RAS-GTPase activating protein that converts active RAS-GTP to inactive RAS-GDP
Loss of neurofibromin leads to sustained RAS-GTP accumulation and downstream MAPK activation
Selumetinib reduces plexiform neurofibroma volume by at least 20 percent in pediatric NF1 patients
NF1 is inherited in an autosomal dominant pattern with 50 percent transmission risk
